eq1_z_bytes.title: Z bytes
eq1_z_bytes.equation: b_k = zeta(L, m, c, px) * px * 3 (+ h); zeta(px) = zeta(px0) * (px / px0)^(eta_m - 1)

residuals.note: repeat residuals of bytes per frame (zstd is deterministic); eta residuals need two sizes

pending.reason: every configuration ran at one size

eq2_z_quality.title: Z quality
eq2_z_quality.equation: sum |decoded - corpus| = 0  =>  SSIM-Y = 1, PSNR-Y = inf, R = 1

eq3_z_cpu.title: Z CPU
eq3_z_cpu.equation: C_comp / N_new = c_0(m) + px * kappa_c(L, m, c); C_dec = N_dec * px * kappa_d(L, m)

pending.reason: every configuration ran at one size, so c_0 and px * kappa_c are not separable; kappa_c = C / (N_new * px)

eq4_z_ram.title: Z RAM
eq4_z_ram.equation: M_comp = M_0 + M_cctx(L, W) + B_c * px * 3; M_dec = M_0 + M_dctx(W) + B_d * px * 3

eq6_run_time.title: run time
eq6_run_time.equation: T = sum over runs of N_new * px * 3 / v(L, m) * repeats

eq7_d_bytes.title: D bytes
eq7_d_bytes.equation: bytes_D = t * (n_new * P + (n_new / tau_f) * (K - P)); P = p_E,c * px * exp(a_E * q) (fitted at tau_f 20 with K folded in)

pending.reason: no tau_f sweep in the input (grid B, D3)

eq7_d_quality.title: D quality
eq7_d_quality.equation: Q_ssim = 1 - s_E,c * exp(-g_E * q); Q_psnr = m_E,c + l_E * q

residuals.note: max_abs_rel and rms_rel are of PSNR; max_abs_ssim is the SSIM error

eq7_d_cpu.title: D CPU
eq7_d_cpu.equation: a_rt = n_new * px * c_comp(-3) + n_new * c_file; a_w = n_new * px * (c_dec(-3) + c_conv) + n_new * c_enc(E, q, px); c_enc = e0_E + e1_E * px * (1 + e2_E * q)

pending.reason: every D run has one px
every DW1 run has one px_out, so e0 and A * px are not separable
every DW2 run has one px_out, so e0 and A * px are not separable

eq7_d_ram.title: D RAM
eq7_d_ram.equation: M_D = M_live + M_worker; M_worker = M0_w + px * (3 + 1.5) * d + M_enc(E, px); M_enc = m0_E + m1_E * px

pending.reason: every D run has one px
every DW1 run has one px_out
every DW2 run has one px_out

eq7_d_qmin.title: D q_min
eq7_d_qmin.equation: q_min(E, px) = min { q : R = 1 on every text scenario }
